headline: Bajrang Lal Agrawal files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Bajrang Lal Agrawal has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition or change in shareholding pattern in Godawari Power and Ispat Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure obligations and potential open offer thresholds.
detail: Bajrang Lal Agrawal has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, the primary regulatory filing mechanism under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires shares such that their holding crosses prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 33%, 49%, 51%, 75%, 90%). The filing by Agrawal in respect of GPIL-an Indian power and steel producer-indicates either a new substantial shareholder entry or an increase in existing holdings. Such disclosures are the foundation for triggering open offer obligations and informational parity in the secondary market.
